title: Make Gallery validation discovery hermetic
requires: Any host building a Gallery production driver and the validation layer
scope: Give every physical Gallery CTest that enables Parallel Mater validation an explicit build-tree validation-layer manifest, so test outcomes never depend on a machine-wide installation or inherited environment.
acceptance: Audit all Gallery CTest registrations and set PM_LAYER_FILES or PM_LAYER_PATH alongside each explicit PM_DRIVER_FILES selection when the test creates a validation-enabled instance.
Add a focused test or inspection check that fails when a validation-enabled physical test omits its local layer manifest and proves discovery uses the intended build artifact.
Run the affected CPU/CUDA/Vulkan Gallery tests available on the host; layer-not-present is not accepted as a skip or physics result.
